name: Beni

queries.query: Beni ville Nord-Kivu division cadastre foncier registre parcellaire demande recherche foncière officiel
queries.scope: Find Beni-Ville-specific land-register and parcel-search services.
queries.result: The Ministry of Land Affairs official search form selects Province and then Circonscription foncière; its public JavaScript maps Nord-Kivu to Beni-Ville and Beni-Territoire as separate jurisdictions. The workflow searches charges, mortgages, or fiscal status by commune/locality and property references and requires applicant identification/documents before submission. I inspected the route and options but submitted no form and no parcel values. No public map or polygon service was found.
queries.executionMethod: French-language primary-source search, official ministry form inspection, and read-only inspection of its client JavaScript to verify the Beni-Ville selector; no identity or property details submitted.

queries.query: Beni DRC official land registry cadastre city parcel search service Beni-Ville North Kivu
queries.scope: Cross-check English source coverage and the city-level registry route.
queries.result: The Ministry’s official search form explicitly provides a Nord-Kivu > Beni-Ville circonscription and identifies property-reference fields for land searches. The government service catalog describes cadastral/title-register consultation through a formal request to the local Conservateur or Cadastre. The form requires applicant identity documents and is not a public geometry viewer; no full parcel polygon response was observed.
queries.executionMethod: English cross-check with official Ministry and public-service catalogue pages; inspected the local-city selector but did not submit the identity-based request.

portals.name: Demande de recherche foncière
portals.operator: Ministère des Affaires Foncières, République démocratique du Congo
portals.observation: Live official search form identifies Beni-Ville under Nord-Kivu as a separate land-registration jurisdiction. Search fields include commune/territory, neighborhood/locality, property-reference and title/registry references. The workflow requires applicant identity and supporting documents; it is not an anonymous vector map.

portals.name: Consultation des registres fonciers, immobiliers et cadastraux
portals.operator: Ministère des Affaires Foncières / CMRAP public-services catalogue
portals.observation: Official catalogue describes access to cadastral and land-title registers by request to the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chief of Cadastre Division; fees and formal review apply.

requests.observation: Official five-step land-search form is live; shows identity, property location/reference, and supporting-document fields.
Official client code contains Nord-Kivu circonscription options including Beni-Ville and Beni-Territoire; no form was submitted.
Public-service catalogue documents formal consultation of cadastral and real-estate registers through a local Conservateur or Cadastre office; no geometry API.
